mapper.select: SELECT lc.id, lc.internal_name, lc.zh_name, lc.en_name, lc.use_volumetric_weight, lc.volumetric_weight_factor, lc.logistic_company_id, lc.active, lc.code, lc.warehouse_in_china, lc.same_price_channel_id, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lcp.channel_id = lc.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS priceFromReference, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lcp.channel_id = lc.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE ref_lc.zh_name END AS priceReferenceChannelName, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lcp.channel_id = lc.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('Uses reference price from ', ref_lc.zh_name) END AS priceNote FROM logistic_channel lc LEFT JOIN logistic_channel ref_lc ON ref_lc.id = lc.same_price_channel_id JOIN logistic_channel_price lcp ON ( lcp.channel_id = lc.id OR lcp.channel_id = lc.same_price_channel_id ) WHERE lc.active = '1' AND lcp.effective_country = #{countryCode} AND lcp.effective_date <= NOW() GROUP BY lc.id, lc.internal_name, lc.zh_name, lc.en_name, lc.use_volumetric_weight, lc.volumetric_weight_factor, lc.logistic_company_id, lc.active, lc.code, lc.warehouse_in_china, lc.same_price_channel_id, ref_lc.zh_name ORDER BY lc.zh_name

SELECT zh_name, en_name FROM logistic_channel WHERE zh_name IN
#{zhName}
